abort.already_configured: This integration has already been added.

data.result_n: Riders shown in the stage result
data.start_n: Riders per team in the startlist
data.past_n: Number of past stages to browse
data.upcoming_days: Show upcoming stages up to (days ahead)
data.max_other: Races next to the shown one in the pop-up

data_description.start_n: While a race has no result yet, the pop-up shows who is at the start, per team by race number. Cyclingstage does not mark a team leader, so this is not a ranking.
data_description.scan_minutes: How often cyclingstage is queried outside of races.
data_description.live_scan_minutes: During a live stage, so the result appears sooner.
data_description.past_n: How far back you can page through the results in the pop-up. 21 is a full grand tour; every stage costs room in the attributes, which are already over the recorder's limit.
data_description.levels: These levels may take the tile and also appear in the pop-up.
data_description.levels_popup: These levels get a button in the pop-up but stay off the tile.
data_description.max_other: 0 shows only the displayed race. Every extra race costs requests at cyclingstage and room in the attributes.
